reviews.x: This burned like crazy, I use many face and under eye products and have never had something burn like this. Please do not buy, burning is not good for your skin.
Very nice product. I am very pleased. I have only been using it 2 days and I can already see results from my dark circles. Smells very nice and it seems like a very luxurious eye cream.

It burned when I used it. I've used many eye creams in the past with little to no effect so I thought I'd give it a try. But not only did it not really work (still have dark circles, dryness, and same amount of wrinkles), the fragrance is way too strong for an eye cream, it burned and not in an it's working way, but in a this seems kind of dangerous way. But also, it didn't absorb into the skin so while I slept it would travel into my eye and I would get little globs of product on my eye causing

But I can testify that I had been using another BIG Name Brand eye cream, and it always caused some eye sensitivity, like an allergy reaction. Watery eyes, sniffles if i had used any more than the teensy-est little bit on the outside of my eye. I could not use it under my eye.  I continued to use that brand because I liked the brand. "Philo....."  But this eye cream CALI

Purchased this for my wife. She sais that it works well and noticed a difference within a few days of using it regularly. It absorbs well into the skin, nice fragrance, a little goes a long way. Reasonably priced and works just as well as more expensive brands.  We’ll definitely buy again
This eye cream goes on very smooth and isn’t greasy. It moisturizes very well. You only need a little bit so this bottle should last a long time. There’s no unpleasant smell either. Very nice product
This eye cream was not hydrating at all and actually flaked off after a few minutes post application under my eye. I have no allergies. Disappointed.

I love this eye cream. Unlike many eye creams, this one actually SINKS IN. It's a non-greasy type of cream, and you can absolutely put your makeup on over it. The other thing I loved is that it has helped with my rough skin. I'm older and have a couple of patches of rough skin on my face (near my eyes). I put this cream on a rough patch near my eye, and in 3 days the roughness was gone and the skin was smooth. I couldn't believe it as that patch had been there for months. I highly recommend this

I just noticed that they have the same exact eye cream for $9.95. The one that costs $11.95 has the word "Enhanced" on the website (not on the container/packaging), and the ingredients listed are exactly the same as the one without "Enhanced" label. So... I'm wondering if they just wanted to raise the price or does it really have an enhanced ingredients in it ?

Within a few days of using this eye cream the swollen bags under my eyes started to decrease. Also my eye lids began to smooth out. I can hardly wait to continue using this eye cream to see the results. I have tried other products. No thanks . . . . no results!  and I mean for several days. This eye cream, the results immediate. Thank you for this wonderful product.

reviews.t: I have bought creams less expensive than this that have done a better job. The skin around my eyes is so ...
reviews.x: Honestly, I’m not that picky about eye cream I just know it’s important to use one. I have bought creams less expensive than this that have done a better job. The skin around my eyes is so dry it burns after using this for just one month. Spend your money elsewhere...I won’t even finish the jar.

I purchased this for dark circles and ordered one for my mom and sister. I’ve been using it only a week and have yet to see results. Can’t seem to find any info on this eye cream etc. or how long before results are noticeable. Not sure if it’s to be applied nightly or in the morning and evening.

reviews.t: It has perfume which irritates the eye even if you don't rub it!
reviews.x: It has perfume in it which is not very good for an eye cream.  If you tear up or rub your eye, it is very irritating.  Most quality face products don't use perfumes in them.  It also dries out in the jar and I've had the lid screwed on tight. A lot gets wasted. I won't buy this product again.

This is an okay eye cream.  My eyes feel fine in the morning.  If I don't wear eyeshadow and primer they get dry in the evening.  If I wear primer and eyeshadow they just feel dry.  It is not horrible and better then some.  I guess it's price point is appropriate.

reviews.t: So far I really like this product
reviews.x: So far I really like this product. After only a couple weeks I’ve noticed decreased eye puffiness even after nights when I’ve gotten little sleep. I don’t feel like my eyes look as tired and my concealer looks better since my undereye area is better hydrated.

reviews.t: Love the way this feels on my eyes
reviews.x: I have a few products from Calily Life and I love them.  They are high quality products at a reasonable price. This eye cream in particular I just started using but I already love it.  I love the texture and the scent. I am optimistic that I will see results.

reviews.t: ... vitamin C serum to help with the beginning of fine lines appearing for this tired mama
reviews.x: I ordered this eye cream and the vitamin C serum to help with the beginning of fine lines appearing for this tired mama. Both products feel great and smell great! I really like this eye cream as my skin feels so soft after I apply it and nourished.

reviews.t: I really like this eye cream
reviews.x: I really like this eye cream. It's light and has a really fresh scent to it. Can't say that it did much for the dark circles but I think it helps some. I've only used it about a week but I'm using it every night and plan on continuing.

I didn't notice any differences after using it for 2 weeks. All the other reviews said this was a miracle product and they loved it. I have not seen any miraculous change. Smell is very light and nice so that is a perk.

Been using this cream for about a month now and I did notice the darkness and puffiness I usually have has gone down. Refreshing to put on, a little goes a long way, but this is also the first eye cream I’ve ever tried.

reviews.t: Dark circle for night shift nurse
reviews.x: Definitely improved my dark circles, however I wish the product was a bit more moisturizing and aided with wrinkles. I have to give props for helping my dark circles considering I work night shift.

reviews.t: So far so good! Under eye area seems moisturized and fine lines ...
reviews.x: So far so good! Under eye area seems moisturized and fine lines less visible. My dark circles are not that prominent can't tell if cream is making a difference but only time will tell.

reviews.t: I started using this product as soon as I received ...
reviews.x: I started using this product as soon as I received it.  It seemed to make a difference with my dark eye circles at first but doesn't seem to help after using it for about a month.
Very pleased, leaves me with a very refreshed looked. It’s very hydrating but not greasy. I have oily skin but I think this will work for all skin types. And it lasts a while.
Like this eye cream.nice creamy consistency, very hydrating and nice light scent...ive only been is less than a week...but I'm optimistic for a positive outcome..Thanks

claims.text: Many reviewers report the cream burns or irritates the eyes, especially those sensitive to its strong fragrance.
Several users say it absorbs well, is non-greasy, and works nicely under makeup.
Some reviewers notice reduced puffiness and dark circles within days to a couple weeks, while others see no results.
Opinions on hydration are mixed, with some finding it moisturizing and others saying it dries out or flakes.
A few reviewers question the price and value, noting cheaper alternatives or duplicate products.
